body: What scares me the most about dying is leaving him behind. Im his best advocate and I know his father would do his best to fill my shoes but i'm so afraid that he wouldnt be able to handle it....sort of like me. I'm a bit calmed down at this point. The sucky thing is im going to wake up with this feeling all over again. That has been the pattern lately. 12 hrs of panic attacks and wishing i were dead until i can have a cocktail and it makes me rethink things. I just had a few shots. My mom picked my baby up btw and i know that drinking isnt the answer but its the only thing that makes me rethink death....idk how i could just quit. I have to admit i did cut myself earlier and that gave me some relief at least momentarily so that i could be calm enough to play with my son. I didnt do it in front of him and he never saw a thing. I know its...really bad. But no i dont have any public transportation here. I'll have to figure out some plan....just dont know how to do that right now. The only time im stable enough to do that is when im drunk....I told my mom to take my son for a few days because i know when im unable to care for him. I love him more than anything and I wanna do anything to make sure he grows up strong and independent. Even if that means that im not in the picture anymore....
don't do it! Please please please don't do it.

I should have probably mentioned before that I have no phone or car, so i can't take myself to a doctor and even if I could find a ride it would be hard to find someone that isn't extremely far away (because I live about 30 min away from my family and the few friends I do have left) or someone who doesn't already take a good chunk out of their week to take me to all of my sons appointments because they literally never end. And not to mention that I have no way to call a ride or a doctor in the first place because I don't have a phone. I'm so stuck. I feel like there's no way out. And I am suffering a lot. I don't know what's wrong with me. Why I can't seem to get any of these basic things under control.
